## What managing Bucktown takes.

### Townhome courts and boutique elevators
Bucktown's side streets mix new-construction townhome communities with boutique elevator condo buildings along Milwaukee and Damen. Both need right-sized budgets, we scale each service plan to the building, not a template.

### Trail and park adjacency
The Bloomingdale Trail's western stretch and Holstein Park anchor Bucktown's residential blocks. Nearby associations see steady buyer demand and expect their buildings maintained to match it.

### Commuter-heavy ownership
With the Clybourn Metra stop and the Blue Line close by, many Bucktown owners are busy professionals who expect portal-first communication, online payments, and board packets that respect their time.

### Do you manage new-construction townhome associations in Bucktown?
Yes. We manage townhome HOAs across Bucktown, including newer developments still working through developer turnover, warranty punch lists, and first-generation budgets. We set up reserves and vendor contracts so early boards start on solid footing.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Bucktown?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Bucktown, Chicago (ZIP 60622, 60647). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Bucktown?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Bucktown association switch to CenterPoint?
